name: sanctuary-api
description: Task-runner shortcuts for the Sanctuary Go backend. This is NOT a Node.js app — zero runtime dependencies. It exists purely so the team's usual `docker compose up -d` -> `pnpm dev` workflow works the same way here as in JS projects.

scripts.dev: docker compose up -d && docker compose logs -f api
scripts.seed: docker compose exec api go run ./cmd/seed
scripts.migrate: docker compose exec -T db psql -U sanctuary -d sanctuary -f - < migrations/20260805090000_initial_schema.sql
scripts.test: docker compose exec api go test ./...
